# Generated by mods/where_to_produce/tools/generate.py. Do not edit by hand.
#
# Scope: country
bag_wtp_plan_run = {
	save_scope_as = bag_wtp_country
	bag_wtp_collect_candidates = yes
	bag_wtp_rebuild_browse = yes
	bag_wtp_plan_clear = yes
	bag_wtp_plan_score = yes
	bag_wtp_plan_allocate = yes
	bag_wtp_plan_rank = yes
	cmf_log = { action = bag_wtp_log_plan }
}

# Everything the last plan left behind, and then the ground this one works over.
#
# Two walks and not one. `_plan_touched` is the *previous* run's ground, which a
# new choice on the map may no longer contain, and a location dropped out of the
# candidates would otherwise keep its buildings -- in the map mode as much as in
# the window. The candidates are walked after it because `_load` has to exist on
# every one of them before a round begins: `bag_wtp_plan_has_room` reads it, and
# a trigger comparing against a variable that is not there logs on every
# candidate of every round.
# Scope: country
bag_wtp_plan_clear = {
	every_in_global_list = {
		variable = bag_wtp_plan_touched
		remove_variable = bag_wtp_plan_dirty
		remove_variable = bag_wtp_plan_rank
		set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_load value = 0 }
		clear_variable_list = bag_wtp_plan_goods
	}
	every_in_global_list = {
		variable = bag_wtp_plan_provs
		remove_variable = bag_wtp_plan_dirty
		clear_variable_list = bag_wtp_plan_here
	}
	clear_global_variable_list = bag_wtp_plan_provs
	clear_global_variable_list = bag_wtp_plan_touched
	clear_global_variable_list = bag_wtp_plan_ranked
	clear_global_variable_list = bag_wtp_plan_results
	every_in_global_list = {
		variable = bag_wtp_candidates
		remove_variable = bag_wtp_plan_dirty
		remove_variable = bag_wtp_plan_rank
		set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_load value = 0 }
		clear_variable_list = bag_wtp_plan_goods
		province_definition = {
			remove_variable = bag_wtp_plan_dirty
			clear_variable_list = bag_wtp_plan_here
		}
	}
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_placed value = 0 }
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_scored value = 0 }
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_found value = 0 }
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_shown value = 0 }
	bag_wtp_plan_count_rooms = yes
}

# The capacity of the chosen ground: every candidate's cap, added up. It is the
# number the two caps are chosen against -- there is no building-slot limit in
# the game to read, so what a cap of three or four is worth can only be seen by
# what it buys, and this is that figure beside the 47 goods asking for it.
# Scope: country
#
# The two caps arrive through their `_show_` script values rather than as
# `add = global_var:`: `add` takes a script value for certain, and everything
# else about the bare form is inference.
# Scope: country
bag_wtp_plan_count_rooms = {
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_rooms value = 0 }
	every_in_global_list = {
		variable = bag_wtp_candidates
		if = {
			limit = { location_rank = location_rank:rural_settlement }
			change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_rooms add = bag_wtp_show_plan_cap_rural }
		}
		else = {
			change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_rooms add = bag_wtp_show_plan_cap_urban }
		}
	}
}

# One scoring pass per good, and the harvest that makes the answers comparable.
#
# **This is the expensive half of the mod, and the reason the plan is a button of
# its own rather than a tick on «Считать».** A single-good run reads about five
# methods on each candidate; this reads all 241 of them, 47 passes over the
# same ground. Whether that survives a button press is the first thing a run has
# to answer.
# Scope: country

# clay: keep the better of the two sides, then divide the ground by its own
# best, so that 1000 means "the province this good wants most" for every good
# alike. A good nothing in this ground can make stays at zero and never picks.
# Scope: country
bag_wtp_plan_harvest_1 = {
	every_in_global_list = {
		variable = bag_wtp_candidates
		# The better of the two sides, and only the number. **The method that won it
		# is deliberately not kept.** A plan row prints the good and not the recipe,
		# so keeping the method would be one more variable per good per location --
		# 47 of them on every candidate -- that nothing reads. Adding it back is
		# one line here on the day a row wants to name the building.
		if = {
			limit = { var:bag_wtp_best >= var:bag_wtp_best_rural }
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_p1 value = var:bag_wtp_best }
		}
		else = {
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_p1 value = var:bag_wtp_best_rural }
		}
	}
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_top value = 0 }
	ordered_in_global_list = {
		variable = bag_wtp_candidates
		order_by = bag_wtp_ord1
		max = 1
		check_range_bounds = no
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_top value = var:bag_wtp_p1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { global_var:bag_wtp_plan_top > 0 }
		change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_scored add = 1 }
		every_in_global_list = {
			variable = bag_wtp_candidates
			# Divided before it is scaled and never after: the top of the ground is
			# already a scaled number, and multiplying first would ask the engine's
			# fixed point for a million.
			change_variable = { name = bag_wtp_p1 divide = bag_wtp_plan_top_value }
			change_variable = { name = bag_wtp_p1 multiply = 1000 }
		}
	}
}

		variable = bag_wtp_candidates
		order_by = bag_wtp_ord9
		max = 1
		check_range_bounds = no
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_top value = var:bag_wtp_p9 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { global_var:bag_wtp_plan_top > 0 }
		change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_scored add = 1 }
		every_in_global_list = {
			variable = bag_wtp_candidates
			# Divided before it is scaled and never after: the top of the ground is
			# already a scaled number, and multiplying first would ask the engine's
			# fixed point for a million.
			change_variable = { name = bag_wtp_p9 divide = bag_wtp_plan_top_value }
			change_variable = { name = bag_wtp_p9 multiply = 1000 }
		}
	}
}

# best, so that 1000 means "the province this good wants most" for every good

		variable = bag_wtp_candidates

			limit = { var:bag_wtp_best >= var:bag_wtp_best_rural }

		}

		}

	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_top value = 0 }

		variable = bag_wtp_candidates
		order_by = bag_wtp_ord10
		max = 1
		check_range_bounds = no

		# one line here on the day a row wants to name the building.
		if = {
			limit = { var:bag_wtp_best >= var:bag_wtp_best_rural }
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_p22 value = var:bag_wtp_best }
		}
		else = {
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_p22 value = var:bag_wtp_best_rural }
		}
	}
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_top value = 0 }
	ordered_in_global_list = {
		variable = bag_wtp_candidates
		order_by = bag_wtp_ord22
		max = 1
		check_range_bounds = no
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_top value = var:bag_wtp_p22 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { global_var:bag_wtp_plan_top > 0 }
		change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_scored add = 1 }
		every_in_global_list = {
			variable = bag_wtp_candidates
			# Divided before it is scaled and never after: the top of the ground is
			# already a scaled number, and multiplying first would ask the engine's
			# fixed point for a million.
			change_variable = { name = bag_wtp_p22 divide = bag_wtp_plan_top_value }
			change_variable = { name = bag_wtp_p22 multiply = 1000 }
		}
	}
}

# lacquerware: keep the better of the two sides, then divide the ground by its own
# best, so that 1000 means "the province this good wants most" for every good
# alike. A good nothing in this ground can make stays at zero and never picks.
# Scope: country
bag_wtp_plan_harvest_35 = {
	every_in_global_list = {
		variable = bag_wtp_candidates
		# The better of the two sides, and only the number. **The method that won it
		# is deliberately not kept.** A plan row prints the good and not the recipe,
		# so keeping the method would be one more variable per good per location --
		# 47 of them on every candidate -- that nothing reads. Adding it back is
		# one line here on the day a row wants to name the building.
		if = {
			limit = { var:bag_wtp_best >= var:bag_wtp_best_rural }
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_p35 value = var:bag_wtp_best }
		}
		else = {
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_p35 value = var:bag_wtp_best_rural }
		}
	}
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_top value = 0 }
	ordered_in_global_list = {
		variable = bag_wtp_candidates
		order_by = bag_wtp_ord35
		max = 1
		check_range_bounds = no
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_top value = var:bag_wtp_p35 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { global_var:bag_wtp_plan_top > 0 }
		change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_scored add = 1 }
		every_in_global_list = {
			variable = bag_wtp_candidates
			# Divided before it is scaled and never after: the top of the ground is
			# already a scaled number, and multiplying first would ask the engine's
			# fixed point for a million.
			change_variable = { name = bag_wtp_p35 divide = bag_wtp_plan_top_value }
			change_variable = { name = bag_wtp_p35 multiply = 1000 }
		}
	}
}

		change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_scored add = 1 }
		every_in_global_list = {
			variable = bag_wtp_candidates
			# Divided before it is scaled and never after: the top of the ground is
			# already a scaled number, and multiplying first would ask the engine's
			# fixed point for a million.
			change_variable = { name = bag_wtp_p47 divide = bag_wtp_plan_top_value }
			change_variable = { name = bag_wtp_p47 multiply = 1000 }
		}
	}
}

# The rounds. Every good takes one location, then every good takes another.
#
# `while` on a `limit` rather than a `count`, because how many buildings a good
# may have is the player's own number. The counter is raised first, so a setting
# of zero does nothing at all rather than looping on a condition it can never
# leave -- the engine's own guard is a thousand iterations, and a mod should not
# be relying on it.
# Scope: country
bag_wtp_plan_allocate = {
	set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_round value = 0 }
	while = {
		limit = { var:bag_wtp_plan_round < global_var:bag_wtp_plan_per_good }
		change_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_round add = 1 }
		bag_wtp_plan_pick_1 = yes
		bag_wtp_plan_pick_2 = yes
		bag_wtp_plan_pick_3 = yes
		bag_wtp_plan_pick_4 = yes
		bag_wtp_plan_pick_5 = yes
		bag_wtp_plan_pick_6 = yes
		bag_wtp_plan_pick_7 = yes
		bag_wtp_plan_pick_8 = yes
		bag_wtp_plan_pick_9 = yes
		bag_wtp_plan_pick_10 = yes
		bag_wtp_plan_pick_11 = yes
		bag_wtp_plan_pick_12 = yes
		bag_wtp_plan_pick_13 = yes
		bag_wtp_plan_pick_14 = yes
		bag_wtp_plan_pick_15 = yes
		bag_wtp_plan_pick_16 = yes
		bag_wtp_plan_pick_17 = yes
		bag_wtp_plan_pick_18 = yes
		bag_wtp_plan_pick_19 = yes
		bag_wtp_plan_pick_20 = yes
		bag_wtp_plan_pick_21 = yes
		bag_wtp_plan_pick_22 = yes
		bag_wtp_plan_pick_23 = yes
		bag_wtp_plan_pick_24 = yes
		bag_wtp_plan_pick_25 = yes
		bag_wtp_plan_pick_26 = yes
		bag_wtp_plan_pick_27 = yes
		bag_wtp_plan_pick_28 = yes
		bag_wtp_plan_pick_29 = yes
		bag_wtp_plan_pick_30 = yes
		bag_wtp_plan_pick_31 = yes
		bag_wtp_plan_pick_32 = yes
		bag_wtp_plan_pick_33 = yes
		bag_wtp_plan_pick_34 = yes
		bag_wtp_plan_pick_35 = yes
		bag_wtp_plan_pick_36 = yes
		bag_wtp_plan_pick_37 = yes
		bag_wtp_plan_pick_38 = yes
		bag_wtp_plan_pick_39 = yes
		bag_wtp_plan_pick_40 = yes
		bag_wtp_plan_pick_41 = yes
		bag_wtp_plan_pick_42 = yes
		bag_wtp_plan_pick_43 = yes
		bag_wtp_plan_pick_44 = yes
		bag_wtp_plan_pick_45 = yes
		bag_wtp_plan_pick_46 = yes
		bag_wtp_plan_pick_47 = yes
	}
}

# clay takes its best free location, or nothing at all.
#
# `max = 1` on an ordered walk is the engine doing the choosing, which is the
# only reason a round over 47 goods is affordable at all. The three conditions
# are the whole rule: the ground has to be worth something to this good, the
# location has to have room under its cap, and the province must not already be
# making it.
# Scope: country
bag_wtp_plan_pick_1 = {
	ordered_in_global_list = {
		variable = bag_wtp_candidates
		limit = {
			var:bag_wtp_p1 > 0
			bag_wtp_plan_has_room = yes
			province_definition = {
				NOT = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_here target = goods:clay } }
			}
		}
		order_by = bag_wtp_ord1
		max = 1
		check_range_bounds = no
		change_variable = { name = bag_wtp_load add = 1 }
		add_to_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_goods target = goods:clay }
		change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_placed add = 1 }
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_variable = bag_wtp_plan_dirty } }
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_dirty value = 1 }
			add_to_global_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_touched target = this }
		}
		# The mark goes on the province definition and not on its locations: the
		# province is the unit the bonus is counted over, so a second building of the
		# same good in the next location along is the same answer twice at the price
		# of a province that had none. One list on one object, rather than the same
		# fact written onto every location of it.
		province_definition = {
			add_to_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_here target = goods:clay }
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { has_variable = bag_wtp_plan_dirty } }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_dirty value = 1 }
				add_to_global_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_provs target = this }
			}
		}
	}
}

		}
		order_by = bag_wtp_ord11
		max = 1
		check_range_bounds = no
		change_variable = { name = bag_wtp_load add = 1 }
		add_to_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_goods target = goods:ivory }
		change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_placed add = 1 }
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_variable = bag_wtp_plan_dirty } }
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_dirty value = 1 }
			add_to_global_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_touched target = this }
		}
		# The mark goes on the province definition and not on its locations: the
		# province is the unit the bonus is counted over, so a second building of the
		# same good in the next location along is the same answer twice at the price
		# of a province that had none. One list on one object, rather than the same
		# fact written onto every location of it.
		province_definition = {
			add_to_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_here target = goods:ivory }
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { has_variable = bag_wtp_plan_dirty } }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_dirty value = 1 }
				add_to_global_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_provs target = this }
			}
		}
	}

		order_by = bag_wtp_ord23
		max = 1
		check_range_bounds = no
		change_variable = { name = bag_wtp_load add = 1 }
		add_to_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_goods target = goods:wild_game }
		change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_placed add = 1 }
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_variable = bag_wtp_plan_dirty } }
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_dirty value = 1 }
			add_to_global_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_touched target = this }
		}
		# The mark goes on the province definition and not on its locations: the
		# province is the unit the bonus is counted over, so a second building of the
		# same good in the next location along is the same answer twice at the price
		# of a province that had none. One list on one object, rather than the same
		# fact written onto every location of it.
		province_definition = {
			add_to_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_here target = goods:wild_game }
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { has_variable = bag_wtp_plan_dirty } }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_dirty value = 1 }
				add_to_global_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_provs target = this }
			}
		}
	}
}

		change_variable = { name = bag_wtp_load add = 1 }
		add_to_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_goods target = goods:lacquerware }
		change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_placed add = 1 }
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_variable = bag_wtp_plan_dirty } }
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_dirty value = 1 }
			add_to_global_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_touched target = this }
		}
		# The mark goes on the province definition and not on its locations: the
		# province is the unit the bonus is counted over, so a second building of the
		# same good in the next location along is the same answer twice at the price
		# of a province that had none. One list on one object, rather than the same
		# fact written onto every location of it.
		province_definition = {
			add_to_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_here target = goods:lacquerware }
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { has_variable = bag_wtp_plan_dirty } }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_dirty value = 1 }
				add_to_global_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_provs target = this }
			}
		}
	}
}

		max = 1
		check_range_bounds = no
		change_variable = { name = bag_wtp_load add = 1 }
		add_to_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_goods target = goods:weaponry }
		change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_placed add = 1 }
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_variable = bag_wtp_plan_dirty } }
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_dirty value = 1 }
			add_to_global_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_touched target = this }
		}
		# The mark goes on the province definition and not on its locations: the
		# province is the unit the bonus is counted over, so a second building of the
		# same good in the next location along is the same answer twice at the price
		# of a province that had none. One list on one object, rather than the same
		# fact written onto every location of it.
		province_definition = {
			add_to_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_here target = goods:weaponry }
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { has_variable = bag_wtp_plan_dirty } }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_dirty value = 1 }
				add_to_global_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_provs target = this }
			}
		}
	}
}

# The rows: one per location that got anything, the busiest first.
#
# A location and not a province, which is the one place this window differs from
# the ranking's. A plan is «build this here», and «here» is a location: the cap
# is a location's, and one province can hold four of them with four different
# answers. Ordered by load, so the «магнит» the feature is named for is the top
# of the table rather than something to look for.
# Scope: country
bag_wtp_plan_rank = {
	# Counted before the rows are taken, and separately from them: the walk below
	# stops at 150 and a count that stopped with it would say the plan used
	# exactly as many locations as the window can draw, whatever it really used.
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_found value = 0 }
	every_in_global_list = {
		variable = bag_wtp_candidates
		limit = { var:bag_wtp_load > 0 }
		change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_found add = 1 }
	}
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_shown value = 0 }
	ordered_in_global_list = {
		variable = bag_wtp_candidates
		limit = { var:bag_wtp_load > 0 }
		order_by = bag_wtp_plan_order
		max = 150
		check_range_bounds = no
		change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_shown add = 1 }
		set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_rank value = global_var:bag_wtp_plan_shown }
		add_to_global_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_ranked target = this }
	}
}

# The window's own list, filled on opening and emptied on closing -- the same
# contract as the other two windows and for the same reason: a scripted widget
# never comes down, so emptying the datamodel is the only thing that frees a row.
# Scope: country
bag_wtp_plan_show = {
	clear_global_variable_list = bag_wtp_plan_results
	ordered_in_global_list = {
		variable = bag_wtp_plan_ranked
		order_by = bag_wtp_plan_rank_order
		max = bag_wtp_show_plan_shown
		check_range_bounds = no
		add_to_global_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_results target = this }
	}
}

# Scope: country
bag_wtp_plan_hide = {
	clear_global_variable_list = bag_wtp_plan_results
}

# The same thing the window's own scripted GUI does, reachable from an effect,
# because a Mod Menu button is script and script cannot reach the interface's
# variable system. The other two windows are closed on the way in: three tables
# of three different questions, and only one of them is the answer to the button
# that was just pressed.
# Scope: country
bag_wtp_open_plan_window_effect = {
	bag_wtp_plan_show = yes
	remove_variable = bag_wtp_result_open
	remove_variable = bag_wtp_right_open
	bag_wtp_hide_results = yes
	set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_open value = 1 }
}
